title: ProposalExpireDueRequest
description: The input of proposal.expire_due: the company to sweep, as a URI, dsor://org_456/tenant/org_456. The sweep expires every READY proposal of that company whose expires_at has come, by the database's clock, so its caller names no proposal and no time (step 25c's README, decisions L3, D6, and D11). The company must be the call's own: the check of the URIs refuses another company's, and DSoR's own check refuses another company's id. This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that expires a proposal. The pattern is the specification's resourceUri; the /tenant/ part beside it is this tutorial's, as in BrakeRequest.
